name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime
description: Type-only dev-time vendored snapshot of the published @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime@0.0.1-rc.1 (lib/types only). The npm package declares @deepseek-ai/dsh-compact as a runtime dependency, but that package is not on any registry, so the package cannot be installed. dsh-context-lens consumes only types from './client' (the useProjection framework seat and ClientContext), never values, so a sanitized type-only copy satisfies the compiler; see IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md 'npm snapshot gaps'.
